name: vitrine
title: Vitrine
character: Objects in a case: each thing on its own pale plate with a numbered museum label, placed asymmetrically on a light stone wall, in a hairline Bodoni and a light Jost.
signature: The plate and label system: numbered plates with museum labels (number, title, material, dimensions, year, price or On request), a running index of plates in the header, and a picture slot that is complete with a drawn silhouette, plan or elevation and takes a photograph when one exists.
